question.text: A PMS whose discretionary and non-discretionary AUM rises from Rs. 900 cr to Rs. 1,200 cr in eligible securities faces which incremental compliance requirement on crossing INR 1,000 cr?

answer.text: Automated system with minimal manual intervention for order management, allocation, audit trail and time stamping

explanation.text: The Logic: Once PMS AUM under discretionary and non-discretionary services crosses INR 1,000 crore, an automated system with minimal manual intervention is required for order management, allocation, audit trail and time stamping. The Trap: Dissolving the fund or exiting the business are not regulatory consequences of crossing the threshold; "no change" ignores the cited automation trigger. Note: The threshold applies to AUM in equity, equity-related instruments, and mutual fund units as specified on the cited source page.
